name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), hard, matches 'the very next move must pick it up again'. After a fall the hands are empty, so holding_box on the next step can only come from a pickup on that step. Response(at_exit, holding_box), hard, matches 'if you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box'. at_exit holds only on the last step, so holding on that step and holding on that step or later coincide. Both sentences are 'if' consequents, not goals, so no Existence is wanted for box_fell or at_exit, and the rule-only warning is valid. No clause is redundant or missing.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the very next step must have the agent holding the box again, meaning it picks the box up again on that next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be carrying the box on that same step.
